summary: Taito's Formula One-style arcade racer, notable for shutter-glasses 3D arcade cabinets and later home-computer ports.

entries.title: Continental Circus

emulation.notes: MAME or original hardware preserves the arcade version; Taito Legends offers official emulated access on PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Windows.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Taito Z System arcade presentation with modern scaling; original 3D cabinet effect requires matching display hardware

primary.why: The arcade version was built around Taito Z System hardware and shutter-type 3D glasses, while the 1989 home conversions lack the arcade 3D presentation. The original arcade cabinet is therefore the highest-fidelity and most authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use a cabinet or emulator setup that preserves the arcade view, and treat Taito Legends as a convenient official emulated fallback.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Taito Z System arcade release with upright and sit-down cabinets using shutter-type 3D glasses.
all_releases.reason: primary: original 3D arcade presentation and highest-fidelity route.
